craft_notes: Sthāyin: parokṣa-dīkṣā unit 2. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 7. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: For accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation one is led to the true guru: in this Mālinī sentence 'prati' is expressive of facing-towards.
l4.sanskrit_cite: bhuktimuktiprasiddhyarthaṃ nīyate sadguruṃ prati ityasminmālinīvākye pratiḥ sāṃmukhyāvācakaḥ
